test_title: PYST 6: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Historians tell us how this country was divided into three.

options.text: We are told by historians how this country has been divided into three.
We are told by historians how this country divided into three.
We are told by historians how this country was divided into three.
We have been told by historians how this country was divided into three.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary task is to convert the given sentence into **passive voice **while retaining its original meaning.
 
• The given sentence is: "**Historians tell us how this country was divided into three.**"
 
• In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The correct passive sentence is: "**We are told by historians how this country was divided into three.**"

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"We are told by historians how this country was divided into three."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "We are told by historians how this country has been divided into three." - This changes the tense of the original sentence.
 
• **Option 2:** "We are told by historians how this country divided into three." - This is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 4:** "We have been told by historians how this country was divided into three." - This changes the tense of the original sentence.
